svg.aria-label: S9 The TLBs, two levels in front of a page walk
svg.text: S9 The TLBs, two levels in front of a page walk
An instruction TLB and a data TLB form the first level, then one shared second level, then the walker. The miss penalties are as measured.
A hit sends the PA to the L1I tag.
A hit sends the PA to the L1D tag.
A hit refills the first level.
beside the L2, shared by the cluster
~ With 16 KiB pages a walk reads three levels.
one TLB holds up to five sizes
a presence vector limits the lookups
scan or look up, whichever is cheaper
ASID and VMID compared four at once
Knowledge base: itlb.entries, itlb.org, dtlb.l1_entries, dtlb.l1_org, dtlb.l1_miss_penalty, dtlb.l1_lookups_per_cycle, dtlb.l2_entries, dtlb.l2_org, dtlb.l2_miss_penalty, dtlb.page_size
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
